name: Scepter SmartControl 1-Gallon Gasoline Can - Spill-Proof Easy Pour Spout
description: Selling a rugged, compact Scepter SmartControl 1-Gallon Plastic Gasoline Can (Model: FR1G101) [Scepter Official](https://www.scepter.com/products/consumer-products/smartcontrol-gasoline-can/1-gallon-smartcontrol-gasoline-can/). This compact fuel jug is perfect for storing and refilling smaller outdoor power equipment such as chainsaws, hedge trimmers, leaf blowers, or for emergency roadside top-offs. Features an integrated child-safe, self-closing SmartControl spill-proof spout with a squeeze-activated flow mechanism to prevent accidental splashes. Fully compliant with EPA, CARB, and ASTM safety standards, it includes an integrated Flame Mitigation Device (FMD) inside the neck for enhanced fire safety. The durable 5-layer HDPE construction prevents vapor leaks. The original multi-language instruction safety label remains perfectly clear and intact on the container housing. Please note: This has been used for normal outdoor tool refueling and stored in a garage. It has been thoroughly emptied, air-dried, and wiped clean, but expects minor exterior storage utility scuffs. Does NOT come with secondary retail storage packaging or bags; local pickup buyers, please bring a trunk liner or plastic tray to prevent any vapor transfer inside your vehicle.
contact_note: Fully pre-assembled and operational. Thoroughly emptied of all fuel before hand-off. Highly compact; fits easily onto any standard car backseat floor or trunk spot. Garage porch pickup available.
meta_description: Scepter SmartControl 1-Gallon Gas Can (FR1G101) for sale. Squeeze-to-start spill-proof spout with Flame Mitigation Device. Cleaned, excellent working condition.
name_zh: 西普特 Scepter 1加仑 智能控流防泼溅塑料便携式应急汽油桶 (型号 FR1G101)
description_zh: 低价转让一个非常实用的西普特（Scepter）SmartControl 1加仑（约3.8升）便携小容量备用汽油桶（官方型号：FR1G101）[Scepter Official](https://www.scepter.com/products/consumer-products/smartcontrol-gasoline-can/1-gallon-smartcontrol-gasoline-can/)。相比大油桶它体积更加轻巧紧凑，非常适合用来给打草机、链锯、吹风机等小型园林工具加油，或者放在后备箱作为汽车长途应急备用油桶 [Home Depot](https://www.homedepot.com/p/Scepter-1-Gal-Smart-Control-Gas-Can-FR1G101/307375058)。配有 SmartControl 智能按压控流喷嘴，带防儿童误触安全锁扣（必须按压绿色安全片并向前推动大绿色滑块才可出油），松手即自动密闭断流。桶身背部的原厂彩色操作说明标签完整无损。内置防火花消焰防爆网（FMD），全重型5层高密度聚乙烯材质。**诚实披露**：属于正常 garage 车库里使用的备用五金工具，外观有正常的轻微堆放摩擦痕迹，出货前已将残留余油彻底清空、控干并擦拭干净。由于属于盛装燃油的特殊容器且极易产生静电，不含原厂外包装或布袋，自提的买家朋友请自带一个塑料垫或者纸托放在后备箱，防止微量气味沾染车内。
